title: Get approval to run a temporary entertainment event
what: Get the council's approval before opening a temporary entertainment event to the public, unless fewer than 250 people are expected.

laws.title: Local Law No. 1 (Administration) 2011
laws.provisions: s 6, sch 2 (operation of temporary entertainment events)

sources.title: Local Law No. 1 (Administration) 2011
sources.quote: A person must not undertake the prescribed activity without a current approval granted by the local government.

sources.title: Local Law No. 1 (Administration) 2011
sources.locator: sch 2 pt 2, definition of operation of temporary entertainment events
sources.quote: operation of temporary entertainment events means the opening to the public, or the preparation for opening to the public, of an entertainment event and for which the opening to the public does not constitute development under the Planning Act.

sources.title: Subordinate Local Law No. 1 (Administration) 2024
sources.quote: A temporary entertainment event held on private property or in a local government controlled area that is expected to be attended by less than 250 people.

sources.title: Local Law No. 1 (Administration) 2011
